prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 67.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Late Sign-In Order Shift: Move sign-in to take place immediately after adoption certificate confirmation, allowing users to pick and customize their pet before creating an account. (why: Overall onboarding completion is low at 25.5%, and allowing users to adopt their pet before asking for auth builds investment.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Shortcut Controls Screen: Insert a dedicated quick-reference screen prior to home intro detailing tray icon management, summon hotkeys, and hide controls. (why: Support logs show multiple user inquiries regarding how to control, hide, or speak to their desktop pet after completing setup.)
2: [home, new_flow] Pre-Spawn Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Flow: Add a monitor and screen permission check step directly after waiting to ensure the desktop pet window renders correctly on screen. (why: Support receives multiple bug reports about pets failing to show up on desktop or the app stalling before rendering.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Warning Hint: Add an explicit explanatory hint on the sign-in screen informing users to log into their primary account to preserve previously saved pets. (why: 8 support emails were received regarding missing or reset pets after users signed in again.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet Desktop Rendering Step Counter: Enable step counter and detailed progress indicators on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting step has a high mean time of 2336s and 84.9% step retention, requiring clearer feedback during long processes.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Goal Clarity Copy: Rewrite choose_path copy to clearly differentiate instant standard adoption from custom photo generation. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s despite median 8s, showing long-tail indecision when picking paths.)
6: [finish, layout] Spotlight Interactive Welcome Layout: Update home_intro screen to a spotlight layout focusing on immediate desktop pet interaction. (why: The finish step has a dropoff with 64.8% completion; spotlight layout focuses user attention on immediate activation.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Audio & Render Launch Alert: Enable desktop notification chimes when pet generation finishes on the waiting screen. (why: Users often background the app while waiting for pet generation and miss when the pet spawns.)

Directly tackles rendering bug reports and high wait times, but involves building diagnostic screens.

Provides clear feedback during the 2336s mean wait time on the home step.
Copy tweak directly targets severe long-tail confusion (514s mean vs 8s median).
Targets the highest dropoff step (finish at 64.8%) with layout engagement improvements.
Informs backgrounded users upon completion of long rendering process at low implementation cost.
